function: Excluded for function: DQN only positions a single movable receive antenna to maximize channel gain; the OTFS channel estimator SBLVI is an iterative Bayesian algorithm, not learned (pp. 3-5).
notes: Reason code function. The only learned component is the DRL agent (p. 4: "we utilize a Deep Q-Network (DQN) combined with the SBLVI channel estimation method to optimize the antenna position"), which moves one receive antenna on a grid to maximize channel gain (p. 3: "We use a single antenna at the receiver"); this is antenna position control, not detection, channel estimation, or beamforming of the seven areas. The OTFS channel estimator SBLVI is an iterative variational Bayesian algorithm with no trained parameters (p. 3: "we update the posterior mean and covariance of channel coefficients using variational Bayes"; Algorithm 1, p. 4) and is compared only with LMMSE and threshold-based embedded pilot (Fig. 6, p. 3), so it is not a learned component for area 4. The link is also single-antenna without RIS (pp. 2-3). Borderline: if the reviewer counts sparse Bayesian learning as learned, the work would be area 4 (OTFS channel estimation, NMSE).
